steps.content: You're trapped under the mud. It floods into your nostrils. All your senses stop functioning almost entirely. The only thing you can hear is Phantom Hamel's whispers of enchantment beside your ear.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: You did come to see me. I'm so happy.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: And you pushed the other two aside, just so you can be alone with me. You do love me, don't you?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I was protecting them from you.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: Hehe, you're lying. You just don't want them to hear what I've got to say to you.
You're bound by black tentacles from head to toe. She taps her finger on your chest where your heart is.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: I'm Hamel. I can see your heart. You absorbed something you don't even understand, and it's clouded your thinking.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: You control Sinners, much the same way we control Corruptors. Your shackles are just like Black Rings. And people guard against you, just like how they guard against us.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: You know it, you know all this. Deep down, you know that Black Ring has never ended. That's why you've been searching, and the search has led you to me.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: What can you tell me then?

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: If anyone can give you the answer you want, it's me. I'm the only one who can understand you, because you and I are in a league of our own; we are the <color=#fb9259>Source</color>. Strong, rare, and lonely.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: That man called me a <color=#fb9259>Corpus</color>, a <color=#fb9259>Host</color>, a <color=#fb9259>great existence</color> that brings about miracles. He says I am going to wake up everyone. And on the day when we all awake, the <color=#fb9259>Miracle</color> will come.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: I didn't understand what he meant. No one ever came to me. I wanted only companionship and love. But even Hamel couldn't stay with me forever.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: Only when your shackles touched me did I realize you were the one I'd been waiting for. You are my kind, you and you alone.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: You are. You'll see.
Her finger splinters into innumerable smaller hands. As they search around, you have a sensation of being gnawed.

Instinctively, you see your shackles' red light flowing out of the places where the hands have touched you. The red light becomes entangled with the hands, and merges with them... It's happening again!

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: See? We're one and the same, you are me, you have only me. Stay with me, or I'll play hardball.
More and more black hands appear. They wrap themselves around your torso tightly, almost making you into a cocoon. Your shackles are still resisting but are losing the battle.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: It's useless. Everything inside the Black Ring is at my service. They bring me inexhaustible power. And you... you're not even willing to make use of the few pathetic creatures under your command.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I will never put their lives at risk!

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: Don't be hung up on them. So annoying. I'm your friend. We're both so lonely, and you...
Her fingers reach deeper inside you. A frenetic roar, a whirlpool that tears at your soul... You fight with all your might, but consciousness is slipping away from you.
Is this the end? Am I going to die here, alone?
In impenetrable darkness, a blue dot of light comes on. As the figure before your eyes fades away, a similar figure comes to your mind. She is dressed all in white, serene and gentle.
Her mouth is moving, as if saying something to you. You remember what she's saying, you won't forget it...

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: Don't forget... You... you're not alone...
Your palm is heating up. Your shackles are burning without you using them.
Someone is approaching! Someone is looking for you!
You clench the shackles. Instantly, a thick column of light penetrates the darkness. A pair of hands grab and tug your arms. The pain is so real. You wake up right away.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Stop playing the ******* hero by yourself!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, take hold of me!
All the black hands restraining you are cut off. You're dragged out of the mud, shaking off all the shadows.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: No...! Don't leave me, don't turn your back on me!!
She is howling, but can do nothing to stop the darkness from being shattered. Light comes in and you see her true form.
The huge bubble, from inside which comes the crying of a baby, stirs!
